elements.name: assembly
elements.description: A container element.

attributes.name: manifestVersion
attributes.description: The manifestVersion attribute must be set to 1.0 .

elements.name: noInherit
elements.description: Include this element in an application manifest to set the activation contexts generated from the manifest with the "no inherit" flag.

elements.name: assemblyIdentity
elements.description: As the first subelement of an assembly element, assemblyIdentity describes and uniquely identifies the application owning this application manifest.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Specifies the application or assembly type.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Uniquely names the application or assembly.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Identifies the language of the application or assembly.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Specifies the application or assembly version.

attributes.name: publicKeyToken
attributes.description: A 16-character hexadecimal string representing the last 8 bytes of the SHA-1 hash of the public key under which the application or assembly is signed.

elements.name: compatibility
elements.description: Contains at least one application .

elements.name: application
elements.description: Contains at least one supportedOS element.

elements.name: supportedOS
elements.description: The supportedOS element has the following attribute.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Set the Id attribute to {e2011457-1546-43c5-a5fe-008deee3d3f0} to run the application using Vista functionality.

elements.name: maxversiontested
elements.description: The maxversiontested element specifies the versions of Windows that the application was tested against starting with the minimum OS version the application supports up to the maximum version.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Set the Id attribute to a 4-part version string that specifies the maximum version of Windows that the application was tested against.

elements.name: dependency
elements.description: Contains at least one dependentAssembly .

elements.name: dependentAssembly
elements.description: The first subelement of dependentAssembly must be an assemblyIdentity element that describes a side-by-side assembly required by the application.

elements.name: file
elements.description: Specifies files that are private to the application.

attributes.name: hashalg
attributes.description: Algorithm used to create a hash of the file.

attributes.name: hash
attributes.description: A hash of the file referred to by name.

elements.name: activatableClass
elements.description: Allows non-packaged desktop apps to make use of user-defined Windows Runtime (WinRT) Components.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Specifies the class identifier for the activatable class.

attributes.name: threadingModel
attributes.description: Represents the apartment threading model to use for activating an in-process server.

elements.name: activeCodePage
elements.description: On Windows 10, this element forces a process to use UTF-8 as the process code page.

elements.name: autoElevate
elements.description: Specifies whether auto elevate is enabled.

elements.name: disableTheming
elements.description: Specifies whether giving UI elements a theme is disabled.

elements.name: disableWindowFiltering
elements.description: Specifies whether to disable window filtering.

elements.name: dpiAware
elements.description: Specifies whether the current process is dots per inch (dpi) aware.

elements.name: dpiAwareness
elements.description: Specifies whether the current process is dots per inch (dpi) aware.

elements.name: gdiScaling
elements.description: Specifies whether GDI scaling is enabled.

elements.name: highResolutionScrollingAware
elements.description: Specifies whether high-resolution-scrolling aware is enabled.

elements.name: longPathAware
elements.description: Enables long paths that exceed MAX_PATH in length.

elements.name: printerDriverIsolation
elements.description: Specifies whether printer driver isolation is enabled.

elements.name: ultraHighResolutionScrollingAware
elements.description: Specifies whether ultra-high-resolution-scrolling aware is enabled.

elements.name: msix
elements.description: Specifies the identity info of a package with external location for the current application (see Grant package identity by packaging with external location ).

attributes.name: packageName
attributes.description: Describes the contents of the package.

attributes.name: applicationId
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the application.

elements.name: heapType
elements.description: Overrides the default heap implementation for the Win32 heap APIs to use.

elements.name: supportedArchitectures
elements.description: For IL-only .NET Framework executables, specifies a list of native processor architectures the application is compatible with.

elements.name: consoleAllocationPolicy
elements.description: Console applications automatically spawn a terminal window (a console host) when launched from Explorer or similar.

elements.name: trustInfo
elements.description: All UAC-compliant apps should have a requested execution level added to the application manifest.

elements.name: requestedExecutionLevel
elements.description: Requested execution levels specify the privileges required for an app.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: The requested execution level is specified with the level attribute of the requestedExecutionLevel descendent of the trustInfo element.

attributes.name: uiAccess
attributes.description: The requestedExecutionLevel element also has an optional attribute uiAccess .
